_status: EXAMPLE values only — not medical advice. Real targets must come from the person's care team.
name: example

protein_g._why: Placeholder ~0.8-1.0 g/kg: balances low muscle (wants more) against kidney disease (wants less). Clinician decides.

carbs_g_per_meal._why: Placeholder ~3 carb choices per meal for diabetes.

kcal._why: Placeholder floor: under-eating and muscle loss are a risk; the care team sets this.

glucose.low_sugar_plan: Follow the doctor's low-blood-sugar plan. Placeholder: 15 g fast sugar (glucose tablets or 1/2 cup apple juice — not orange juice, which is high in potassium), recheck in 15 minutes.

body._status: PLACEHOLDER thresholds — confirm with the care team.
body._why: Weight loss = under-eating / muscle loss. Fast gain = possible fluid retention (kidneys) — call the doctor.
